allow: Bash(powershell -Command "New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'Wrangler Dev Server' -Direction Inbound -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 8080 -Action Allow")
Bash(git commit -q -m 'Point canonical, sitemap and structured data to k2lcoolaircon.com *)

PowerShell(foreach \($h in 'k2lcoolaircon.com','www.k2lcoolaircon.com'\) { "== $h"; try { Resolve-DnsName $h -Server bethany.ns.cloudflare.com -DnsOnly -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object Name,Type,IPAddress,NameHost | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String } catch { "  " + $_.Exception.Message } })

PowerShell(ipconfig /flushdns; Clear-DnsClientCache; try { Resolve-DnsName k2lcoolaircon.com -Type A -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object Name,IPAddress | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String } catch { "local resolver still: " + $_.Exception.Message }; \(Get-DnsClientServerAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object ServerAddresses | Select-Object -First 3 InterfaceAlias,ServerAddresses | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String\))

PowerShell("router 192.168.1.1:"; try { Resolve-DnsName k2lcoolaircon.com -Type A -Server 192.168.1.1 -DnsOnly -ErrorAction Stop | Format-Table Name,Type,IPAddress -AutoSize | Out-String } catch { $_.Exception.Message }; "windows cache:"; Get-DnsClientCache -Entry k2lcoolaircon.com -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table Entry,Status,TimeToLive -AutoSize | Out-String)

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8788 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$\($_.OwningProcess\)"; "{0} {1} pid={2} {3}" -f $_.LocalAddress, $_.LocalPort, $_.OwningProcess, \($p.CommandLine -replace '\\s+',' '\).Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(160,$p.CommandLine.Length\)\) })

PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'workerd.exe' -or \($_.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'wrangler'\) } | ForEach-Object { "kill $\($_.ProcessId\) $\($_.Name\)"; Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue })
